messages.subject: Project Helio — first draft MSA for review
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Attached is our first draft of the Master SaaS and Data Services Agreement (v1). Key commercial points are in clause 6 and Schedule 1 (charges) and clause 11 (liability). We have set the general liability cap at 100% of annual charges with a £5m super-cap for data protection and confidentiality breaches — this is our opening position; expect Castle & Vane to push on both.

Please let me have any comments before we issue to the other side.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
